description: Submit an AI agent action proposal to Proof Layer for governance evaluation. Returns a cryptographically-signed receipt with a verdict of EXECUTE, BLOCK, REVIEW, or SHADOW. Use this before any consequential agent action (sending emails, modifying data, making payments, etc.).

agent_id.description: Identifier for the AI agent making the proposal

guardian_timeout_policy.description: What to do if the Guardian times out. Default: fail_closed (block the action)

idempotency_key.description: Optional unique key — same key returns the cached receipt

parameters.description: Action-specific parameters as a JSON object

name: pl_evaluate
